name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Maid, Bathing, and Gardening go with Crane, Pierce, and Ravenscroft, in some order.
Either Butler goes with Crane or Cooking goes with Valet.
Either Walking goes with Doctor or Ravenscroft goes with Valet.
Butler goes with at least one of Ravenscroft, Bathing, or Walking.
Between Doctor and Governess, one goes with Holloway and the other with Bathing.

At least one of Governess goes with Pierce, Bathing does not go with Crane, or Gardening goes with Holloway if and only if at least one of Maid does not go with Painting, Bathing does not go with Governess, or Doctor does not go with Holloway.
